:::{#cor-conditional-surprisal-difference}
#### Conditional surprisal as a difference

For $X$, $Y$, $x$ and $y$ as in @thm-surprisal-chain-rule,

$$s(y \mid x) = s(x, y) - s(x).$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Subtract $s(x)$ from both sides of @thm-surprisal-chain-rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}
s(x, y) - s(x)
&= s(x) + s(y \mid x) - s(x) \\
&= s(y \mid x).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
